summary: The F2b schema at pin 55d0a1ea9bda is substantively strong: class separation from F2a is clean, no C2 assumption is imported, the conclusion_type is distinguishable, there is no conclusion inflation, and the falsifier is scoped and decidable. It cannot be accepted at this hash: the f0_binding hash chain does not resolve at current bytes. f0_binding.consistency_evidence_sha256 declares 675a99d0... but artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json measures 9e335e9b... (495 bytes), which is the value pinned by FROZEN revision 28; the declared value is the rev27-era evidence content. Under the bind-chain addendum this is a hash-bound hard failure. Two medium findings (cross-class containment needs a smooth-category reconciliation; i_plus_regularity k is assumed but unbounded) and two low/annotation items are recorded. The known soft flag at line 316 is disposed of explicitly as an annotation, not class leakage. No gate verdict is set; worker events cannot move gates.

FROZEN revision 28 (artifacts/formulation/FROZEN.json, sha256 2f358f6722d920621a66c0259cb48d35a5e3c1b706f28adf37ed467325fcedf1) pins artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json at the measured value 9e335e9b..., so the canonical manifest agrees with disk and the schema declaration is the stale side.

Copies of the declared content survive as pinned snapshots, e.g. artifacts/worker-022/evbind_guard/pinned/taxonomy_consistency.675a99d0d25b.json, artifacts/worker-043/w043d_r2_durability/w043d_r2_f0ap_h1x/artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json, confirming 675a99d0... was a real pre-rev28 revision of the evidence rather than a typo.
The same stale declaration appears in schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml (F1) and schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml (F2a), so this is a systematic repin miss, not an F2b-only transcription error.

The evidence file mtime (00:49:57+08:00) is later than the binding's checked_at (00:31:41+08:00) and later than FROZEN rev28 (00:35:08+08:00); its bytes have been re-generated idempotently at least once after the schema was frozen.
hard_failures.consequence: The f0_binding chain is not coherent at the current bytes. A gate verdict at the pinned schema hash cannot claim a hash-bound consistency check on the strength of this declaration; any coverage that treats rev12 as verified-with-resolved-hashes is blocked until the pin is refreshed. Accept is excluded by the assignment's bind-chain falsifier (an accept with a declared sha256 that does not equal the measured file).
hard_failures.required_fix: Refresh f0_binding.consistency_evidence_sha256 from 675a99d0... to 9e335e9b... in schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml, re-run the consistency check so checked_at postdates the evidence bytes, and re-pin through the owner and artifact event; apply the identical one-line repair to F1 and F2a. Preserve the old hash in revision_history.
hard_failures.falsifier: A re-measurement of artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json at its current bytes returning 675a99d0... (it does not), or a schema revision whose declared evidence hash equals the measured file at the same bytes.

findings.observation: The C0 frozen predicate requires M' to be a SMOOTH (C-infinity) 4-manifold (clause (c)) and iota to be a C-infinity isometric embedding (non_vacuity.iota_regularity), while the C2 sibling predicate that the same ledger quantifies over (schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml:90-97) pins neither the manifold category nor the embedding regularity; F2a clause (c) says only 'M' is connected and time-orientable'. The consequences E_C2 subset of E_H2loc subset of E_{C1,1} subset of E_C0 and the entailment C0-inextendibility => C2-inextendibility are then asserted at the level of literal predicates without the smoothing/regularity-improvement step that carries a C2 extension (possibly on a merely C2 manifold with a non-smooth iota) into the C0 category.
findings.why_it_matters: The whole strength ordering and the C0=>C2 entailment, which the schema uses to call C0 the strongest class and to forbid the converse, rest on this containment. The mathematical content is standard (C^k 4-manifolds, k>=1, admit compatible smooth structures) but it is a proof obligation, not a definitional identity; leaving it unrecorded is exactly the kind of scope gap a gate should not silently absorb.
findings.recommended_fix: Either propagate the worker-16 F2b-16-03 smooth-category convention explicitly into F2a's extension_predicate (so the C2 extension is smooth-manifold/C-infinity-embedding by definition), or add the smoothing/regularity-improvement lemma as a named proof obligation on implication_ledger.extension_class_containment.
findings.falsifier: Exhibit an extension that satisfies the C2 sibling predicate as literally written (C2 metric, no smooth-manifold or C-infinity-embedding requirement) but no extension satisfying the C0 predicate, which would break the unqualified containment; a recorded smoothing lemma discharges the obligation.

findings.observation: regularity.i_plus_regularity states 'gtilde extends to I+ with C^k regularity, k >= 3; k is part of the assumption', but k appears in no quantifier domain, no D0/D2 definition, and no tie to the tagged index r. The rev12 F-2 well-typedness repair typed r exactly; it left k free. A reader cannot tell whether k>=3 is (i) an independent hypothesis on each datum, (ii) a consequence of the declared decay/regularity branch, or (iii) a domain restriction on the class.
findings.why_it_matters: The SCC conclusion is quantified over data in G_r; if k>=3 is a standing assumption that is not part of D2/X^r_vac, the class silently narrows and the genericity statement is about a smaller data set than the scope_statement suggests. For the smooth-with-decay branch this is expected to hold; for the Sobolev branch (s > 5/2, delta in (1/2,1)) it is not shown.
findings.recommended_fix: Bind k in the quantifier block (e.g. r carries the I+ regularity, or add an explicit hypothesis field with its own binder and a definition_ref), or state and cite the derivation of k>=3 from each branch of D0. The same wording occurs in F1/F2a and should be aligned family-wide.
findings.falsifier: A datum in G_r (Sobolev branch) whose maximal development does not extend to I+ with C^3 regularity, or a formal reading in which k>=3 is an unbound free parameter, falsifies the well-typedness claim as written.

findings.observation: genericity.ambient_space justifies Baire-ness by 'X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire'. That is accurate for the weighted Sobolev branch H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1}, but the smooth-with-decay branch is described as a Frechet space whose topology (the seminorm family) is named but never defined, and a Frechet space is not a Banach space. The conclusion (Baire) still holds, but by the Frechet Baire theorem, not the stated reason.
findings.why_it_matters: Comeagerness is defined relative to the topology; for r = smooth the topology that makes 'meager' meaningful is under-specified, and the stated Banach justification does not cover it. This is a documentation gap, not an error, but it is on the definitional path of the class quantifier.
findings.recommended_fix: Define the Frechet seminorms for the smooth-with-decay branch (or cite the standard weighted-Frechet convention) and split the Baire justification per branch.
findings.falsifier: A reading under which the smooth branch's ambient space is not Baire, or two readers computing different comeager sets for r = smooth because the topology differs.

findings.observation: Line 316 is provenance.sources entry {concept: 'H2_loc-inextendibility results and why they are not C0', identifier: null, status: unresolved, needed_for: 'anti_scope, must_not_conflate'}. The candidate-variant token H2_loc appears only inside the free-text concept string of a citation-tracking field.
findings.disposition: NOT class leakage. The token is not class-id-shaped (no AF- prefix), it does not appear in any class_id or class_ids field (programmatic walk of the parsed schema returns only AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH), the same artifact registers H2LOC as parent_class AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN + variant_id in anti_scope (line 274), and VARIANT_REGISTRY.json's class_id_rule forbids variant ids in class_ids fields. The entry is an unresolved-source note whose stated purpose is anti_scope/must_not_conflate.
findings.residual_blind_spot: The provenance entry omits the parent_class/variant_id qualifier, so a reader skimming provenance.sources could read 'H2_loc-inextendibility results' as a separate class name. This is cosmetic; it can be removed by rewriting the concept as 'H2_loc (variant H2LOC of AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN) inextendibility results'.

The aggregator's own SEP-6 rule and review note say a component revision after 2026-09-12T00:15+08:00 invalidates the pins and must fail the integration lint until re-pinned.
findings.why_it_matters: These files are not part of the f0_binding chain of the artifact under review, so they are not a hard failure of F2b; but they live on canonical paths and a reviewer or downstream consumer that trusts them will measure a mismatch. The aggregator's canonical_gate: pass is stale-by-its-own-rule.
findings.recommended_fix: Regenerate or delete the sidecar, and re-pin/re-run the aggregator (or mark it invalid) against 55d0a1ea... and 5476a3f2...; this is formulation hygiene, not part of the F2b verdict.

class_separation_check.detail: F2b freezes extension_regularity C0 with extension_solution_concept none; the extension metric is required to be only continuous and nondegenerate, with no differentiability, curvature, or equation requirement (lines 83-107, 147-155). The C2 sibling's classical Ric(g')=0 and C2 metric requirements appear in F2b only as the sibling's distinct predicate, never as hypotheses. The one-way direction C0 => H2loc => C2 (and C0 => C2) is stated consistently at lines 79, 153, 231, 238-243, 249, and the converse is forbidden at lines 245-246. No composite 'C0 or C2' token occurs; a programmatic walk of class_id/class_ids fields returns only the four frozen class ids, with H2LOC/DISTRIBUTIONAL/CH carried as variant references of the correct parent.
class_separation_check.wcc_detail: i_plus.in_conclusion false, visibility.role not_in_conclusion, and the forbidden lists at lines 155, 197, 206, 227 exclude I+ completeness, visibility, and WCC falsifiers from this class.

conclusion_inflation_check.detail: conclusion.epistemic_status is open_problem with an explicit promotion_rule (line 33) and claim_promotion (line 235); no theorem or counterexample is promoted from a model or calibration. known_status quarantines T-301 to variant CH and records why the frozen class is not recorded as refuted (lines 301-307). falsifier.tier_2 is explicitly labelled refutes_strengthening_only (lines 259-262), and provenance.known_status_signals is explicitly marked NOT asserted by this schema (line 322). The candidate tool at line 80 is citation_status unresolved and forbidden as a proof import.

declared_open_items: correct definition of extension for merely continuous metrics
assumption_completeness_check.positives: The genericity well-definedness (subspace topology, Baire, non-emptiness), the C0 uniqueness caveat, the Kerr obstruction, the forbidden/weakener mislabel repairs, and the L1 status quarantine are all present and internally consistent.

falsifier_check.detail: falsifier.tier_1 gives an explicit witness type (explicit extension in the frozen class) with machine-checkable steps and names the one non-machine-checkable step (non-meagerness of the extendible set), together with routes R1/R2 (lines 251-258). tier_2 is correctly restricted to the stronger 'forall data' statement, and schema_falsifiers excludes wrong-family (visible singularity) and weaker-evidence citations. The class-level falsifier is therefore decidable in principle with its undecidable sub-step disclosed.
